A Perfect Void: Wyrd Power (Free), Continuous Effect: while maintained, the Wyrd counts as always being in cover and within a weapon's Long Range to all enemy Fighters within 10".
Adrenaline Surge: Play when a friendly Fighter activates, before any actions. The Fighter may perform one additional action during this activation.
Ally of House Delaque: If recruited by a Delaque gang, a Whisper Merchant's Credit Cost is reduced to 45 credits.
Ammo (5+): After the weapon fires, roll a D6. On X or more there is ammo left; otherwise it is Out of Ammo. If an Out of Ammo symbol is also rolled on the Firepower dice, the weapon jams for the rest of the battle.
Ammo (6+): After the weapon fires, roll a D6. On X or more there is ammo left; otherwise it is Out of Ammo. If an Out of Ammo symbol is also rolled on the Firepower dice, the weapon jams for the rest of the battle.
Auxiliary: Can only be attached to another weapon and not taken on its own. It does not use one of the model's three weapon slots.
Backstab: This weapon gains +1 Strength if the target is Engaged with more than one model.
Banewaters (Synth Still): Synth Still. Boons: Income: 20 credits. Battlefield effect: Toxic Vats: +1 AP for weapons with Toxin (X+).
Bio-booster: The first time each battle the bearer gains the Injured Condition, reduce the Lethality of the weapon damaging them by 1. If that makes it zero, roll 2 Injury dice and the bearer chooses which to apply.
Blast (3\"): Place the Blast marker centred on the target. If the Hit roll fails, it scatters D6". Any model with its base at least partially under the marker suffers one automatic Hit.
Blaze (5): If the Wound roll is at least X, the target suffers an additional Hit with the same profile, even if the first failed to wound. The extra Hit rolls to wound separately and cannot cause further Hits.
Blaze (5+): If the Wound roll is at least X, the target suffers an additional Hit with the same profile, even if the first failed to wound. The extra Hit rolls to wound separately and cannot cause further Hits.
Bulging Biceps: When performing a Braced Shot action, the Fighter may move up to their Initiative in inches before or after the attack. When attacking with a Heavy weapon in close combat, they may declare a Secondary weapon as long as it is not also Heavy.
Bull Charge: When the model makes close combat attacks as part of a Charge action, any close combat weapons they use gain the Knockback (6+) trait and are resolved at +1 Strength.
Burrowing: The Wyrm can move freely under impassable terrain if it has enough movement, but may not end its move on or within impassable terrain.
Concussive (5+): If this weapon Wounds and the Wound roll is at least X, the target reduces their Initiative by 1 until the end of their next activation.
Counter-attack: When an enemy model resolves a Fight action involving this model, this model may make an additional attack with their weapon, resolved at the same Initiative as the enemy's attacks.
Critical Injury: Lasting Injury (63-65): the Fighter is in a critical condition. If their injuries are not treated by a visit to the Doc in the Post-cycle Sequence, they will die.
Crossfire: Play when a friendly Fighter activates, before any actions. A ranged attack against an enemy another friendly Fighter has already targeted this round automatically hits (still roll for weapon traits).
Damage (2): A model wounded by this weapon loses X Wounds rather than one. Injury dice rolled still equal the weapon's Lethality.
Eternal Slumber: Wyrd Power (Single): choose a Seriously Injured enemy Fighter within 3" and Line of Sight. They immediately go Out of Action.
Eye Injury: Lasting Injury (51): the Fighter goes into Recovery and reduces their Ballistic Skill by 1.
From the Shadows: Instead of deploying normally, this Fighter may be set aside. At the start of any round after the first, before rolling for Priority, set them up anywhere out of Line of Sight of all enemies and more than 9" from any enemy Fighter.
Generatorium: Generatorium. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Reputation: +1 Reputation while held. Battlefield effect: Power Glow: the Visibility (X") rule has no effect.
Graviton Pulse: Instead of rolling to Wound, any model in the blast must make a Strength check; if failed, they are wounded with no Armour saves. The marker stays as difficult terrain; at the start of each End phase it remains on a 5+.
Grenade Bouquet: Play when a friendly Fighter makes a ranged attack with a Blast grenade, before rolling to Hit. They make three separate attacks at the same model; all automatically scatter, and the weapon then runs Out of Ammo.
Grievous Wound: Lasting Injury (31-46): the Fighter goes into Recovery.
Gunfighter: This Fighter may fire two weapons with the Light trait as part of a single Shoot action. Each may fire at a different target, declared before any dice are rolled.
Hand Injury: Lasting Injury (52): the Fighter goes into Recovery and reduces their Weapon Skill by 1.
Heaviside Hab-layer (Settlement): Settlement. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Recruit: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0). Battlefield effect: None
Heavy: A ranged weapon with this trait can only be fired using the Braced Shot action. A close combat weapon with this trait may not be a Secondary weapon, and no Secondary weapon may be used alongside it.
Hidden Stash: Play when a friendly Fighter activates, before any actions. During this activation they may perform the Reload action as a Free action.
Hip-shooting: All ranged weapons without the Heavy trait this Fighter is equipped with gain the Assault trait.
Inspiring: A Fighter with this skill may perform the Group Activation action as a Free action.
Juggernaut: When hit by a ranged attack, this model is only Suppressed if they either lose a Wound or an Injury dice is rolled and applied to them.
Knockback (6+): If the Hit roll is at least X, the Fighter hit is moved 1" directly away from the attacker, testing for falling if pushed off a ledge. This can break engagements.
Lance: While carried by a Fighter with the Mounted subtype, this weapon gains +1 Strength for attacks made as part of a Charge action.
Las-projector (long rifle): Reduces the benefit a model gains to their Armour save for being in cover by 1 while within this weapon's Short Range.
Leash Range (12\"): The pet must stay within this distance of its owner.
Lesson Learnt: Lasting Injury (11): the Fighter earns D3 XP.
Lie Low: While this Fighter is Suppressed, enemy models cannot target them with a ranged attack unless they are within the attacking weapon's Short Range.
Light: May be used as a Primary or Secondary weapon in close combat, though only one attack may be made with it regardless of Attacks, skills or traits. With Template, one opposing model suffers one automatic hit in close combat.
Master of Whispers: When added to a Gang Roster, this Fighter may gain the Wyrd subtype and select a Psychoteric Whispers Wyrd Power for +35 credits.
Medicate: While Active or Suppressed, this Fighter may perform the Heal Ally (Single) action: select a friendly Fighter within 1" who is not Seriously Injured. They regain 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle.
Melee: A weapon with this trait is used to make attacks whilst Engaged.
Mesh armour: Increases the Save characteristic by 1 when resolving Hits suffered in close combat.
Mono-sight (long rifle): When performing an Aimed Shot with this weapon, apply a +2 modifier to the Hit roll instead of +1.
Nerves of Steel: When the model is hit by a ranged attack, they may make a Cool check. If the check is passed, they are not Suppressed by the attack.
Overwatch: If Active with a Ready marker and Line of Sight to the target, this model can interrupt an enemy action as soon as it is declared: it loses its Ready marker and performs a Shoot action at that enemy. If the enemy is Suppressed or Seriously Injured, their activation ends immediately.
Paired (2): Can never be a Secondary weapon, and no Secondary weapon may be used alongside it. When selected as a Primary weapon, the bearer increases their Attacks by X.
Parry: If used as a Primary or Secondary weapon in a combat, the model increases their Save by 1 (more than one Parry weapon gives no extra benefit).
Personal Enmity (Macavity): Lasting Injury (14): the Fighter gains the Hatred (X) Condition, where X is the model that took them Out of Action.
Precision Shot: If the Hit roll for a ranged attack made by this model is a natural 6 (with a weapon without the Blast or Rapid Fire (X) trait), the shot hits an exposed area and no Armour save can be made.
Promethium Cache: Promethium Cache. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Equipment: instead of income, add three hazard suits to the Stash for free. Battlefield effect: Plentiful Promethium: improve Blaze (X+) by 1, so Blaze (5+) becomes Blaze (4+).
Psychoteric Node: When a Delaque Wyrd uses a Psychoteric Power, they may channel it through an Active Psychoteric Wyrm they own within Leash range. Line of Sight, distance and range are measured from the Wyrm.
Psychoteric Wyrm (Rumpus): A pet with a 12" Leash range. Its owner can channel Psychoteric Powers through it (Psychoteric Node), and it can burrow under impassable terrain.
Pyroclave (Promethium Cache): Promethium Cache. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Equipment: instead of income, add three hazard suits to the Stash for free. Battlefield effect: Plentiful Promethium: improve Blaze (X+) by 1, so Blaze (5+) becomes Blaze (4+).
Rain of Blows: The first time each activation this model resolves a Fight action, if they are still Engaged with an enemy model they may perform an additional Fight action as a Free action.
Rapid Fire (1): Follows the rules for Rapid Fire: roll Firepower dice to see how many hits are scored and whether the weapon runs out of ammo.
Rapid Fire (2): Follows the rules for Rapid Fire: roll Firepower dice to see how many hits are scored and whether the weapon runs out of ammo.
Rendermarch (Corpse Farm): Corpse Farm. Boons: Income: 25 credits. Battlefield effect: Paid in Kind: gangs earn 10 credits for each enemy model they take Out of Action.
Rending (6+): If the natural Wound roll is at least X, increase the weapon's AP by 1 for that attack (AP -1 becomes AP -2).
Rippershop (Rogue Doc Shop): Rogue Doc Shop. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Recruit: instead of income, if the gang has no Rogue Doc, recruit one for 30 credits less. Battlefield effect: Supplies Everywhere: a fighter offering assistance adds two Injury dice instead of one.
Rogue Doc Shop: Rogue Doc Shop. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Recruit: instead of income, if the gang has no Rogue Doc, recruit one for 30 credits less. Battlefield effect: Supplies Everywhere: a fighter offering assistance adds two Injury dice instead of one.
Settlement: Settlement. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Recruit: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0). Battlefield effect: None
Shock (5+): If the Hit roll is at least X, the attack automatically Wounds and counts as a natural 6 on the Wound roll for other traits.
Shred (5+): If this weapon Wounds and the Wound roll is at least X, increase its Lethality by 1 for that attack.
Shred (6+): If this weapon Wounds and the Wound roll is at least X, increase its Lethality by 1 for that attack.
Single Shot: Can only be fired once per battle, then automatically goes Out of Ammo and cannot be reloaded.
Spring Up: If this Fighter is Suppressed when activated, make an Agility test. If it is passed, they are no longer Suppressed and may perform two actions as normal.
Stimm-slug stash: Once per battle, at the start of their activation: +2 Movement, Strength and Toughness until their next activation. Then roll a D6; on a 1 they suffer a Str -, AP -, L1 hit that automatically Wounds with no saves.
Suppressing Fire: Play after a friendly Fighter has resolved a ranged attack. The target is Suppressed, whether the attack hit or not. Skills cannot prevent it.
Tallow Wick (Settlement): Settlement. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Recruit: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0). Battlefield effect: None
Template: Place the teardrop template with the narrow end touching the firing model. Any model even partially under it is hit automatically; no Hit roll is needed.
Terrible Truths: Wyrd Power (Single): choose an enemy Fighter within 6" and Line of Sight. They must make a Willpower check; if failed, they gain the Insanity Condition.
Thunderous Charge: Play when a friendly Fighter declares a Charge, before rolling. Roll two D6 instead of one for the charge distance and choose which to add to their Movement.
Toxin (3+): Against a Fighter, instead of comparing Strength to Toughness, the target is wounded on a result of X+. Against a Vehicle, it only wounds on a natural 6.
Turbine 10.2 (Generatorium): Generatorium. Boons: Income: 15 credits. Reputation: +1 Reputation while held. Battlefield effect: Power Glow: the Visibility (X") rule has no effect.
Twin-linked: When making a ranged attack, the Firepower dice may be re-rolled (all of them must be re-rolled).
Unstable: If the Hit roll is a natural 1, the model using the weapon suffers an automatic Hit from it and no other models are hit. Weapons that don't roll to Hit roll a D6 first.
Unwieldy: When attacking with this weapon in close combat, the model's Initiative is set to 1 before applying any modifiers.
Useful Lies: During the Pre-battle and Post-battle Sequences, the gang may count a single D6 roll as a 6 when determining starting crew (random crew size), rolling on the Escape table, or receiving rewards. Once per sequence; note each use on the roster. After six uses the Whisper Merchant calls in their debt: pay their Credit Cost again or remove them.
Web: Armour saves cannot be taken against this weapon, though Invulnerable saves can. A Fighter wounded by it gains the Webbed Condition instead of losing a Wound.
Whispers in the Dark: When added to a Gang Roster, this Fighter selects a Psychoteric Whispers Wyrd Power.
You!: Play when a friendly Fighter activates, before any actions. Pick an enemy Fighter: +1 to Wound rolls against them for the rest of the battle, but while they are on the battlefield, any action targeting an enemy must target them.
Personal Enmity (Elijah): Lasting Injury (14): the Fighter gains the Hatred (X) Condition, where X is the model that took them Out of Action.
